My hosting recommendation: Cloudflare

I've reviewed the current hosting options. For Danijela's particular website, I would choose Cloudflare over Vercel at launch.

Here's why.

Platform

Starting cost

My assessment

Cloudflare Pages

$0 for static hosting

Recommended for the initial website

Vercel Pro

From $20/month + applicable usage/taxes

Excellent if we adopt Next.js or need more dynamic functionality

Netlify

Free tier, usage credits

Good alternative, particularly for simple deployment

Cloudflare supports static sites, custom domains, HTTPS and a global delivery network. Its static asset requests are free and unlimited under the documented pricing model.

Cloudflare Pages docs+2

Vercel is an excellent platform, but its free Hobby plan is explicitly restricted to non-commercial projects. Since this website advertises Danijela's paid services, we should use its Pro tier if we choose Vercel.

vercel.com+1

The architecture I recommend

danijelamarjanovic.rs

DNS, HTTPS, CDN and static website hosting

Website + future blog

For the production website, I would favor Astro with Cloudflare hosting. Astro's static-first approach fits this type of content-focused professional site particularly well.

It would give us excellent control over layout, SEO, structured data, articles and future editorial expansion without building an unnecessarily complicated application.

We can add a simple content-management interface later if Danijela wants to publish articles herself.

One recent change worth noting: Cloudflare's documentation now recommends Workers as its primary platform for new applications, while Pages remains available. We'll evaluate the appropriate Cloudflare deployment target when setting up Astro rather than locking into a legacy workflow prematurely.

Cloudflare Pages docs
